【The New CEO】 Julian announces that he will personally oversee the arts foundation and recruits Lauren after overhearing her criticism.
【The Same Vision】 Lauren realizes Julian genuinely wants to support artists, and their shared purpose creates their first flirtatious moment.
【After Hours】 Julian remembers Lauren’s coffee order and reveals that the foundation was the dream of his late mother, a public-school art teacher.
【Building It Together】 While adjusting a painting’s position, Julian and Lauren move increasingly close and can no longer ignore their attraction.
【More Than the Foundation】 Julian admits that he wants more time with Lauren and promises to ask her out after the opening.
【The Final Question】 After dedicating the foundation to his mother and publicly thanking Lauren, Julian asks her on a date, and she accepts.
Possible Characters: • Julian Cross — handsome American CEO in his early thirties; outwardly controlled and demanding, privately earnest, attentive, and awkward with romance. • Lauren Hale — capable American junior arts-foundation coordinator in her late twenties; overlooked but confident, thoughtful, and willing to challenge authority. • Host — polished adult American event host who briefly introduces Julian at the employee gathering.
